summary.text: Tina Kotek is the incumbent Governor of Oregon, a Democrat seeking a second term. She was a state representative from Portland from 2007 to 2022 and House Speaker from 2013 to 2022. As governor she has declared and repeatedly extended a homelessness emergency, signed a statewide shelter program, and signed a series of housing-construction bills.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.S. in religious studies from the University of Oregon and a master's degree from the University of Washington; worked as a policy advocate for the Oregon Food Bank and Children First for Oregon.

Served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2007 to 2022 and as Speaker from 2013 to 2022, the longest-serving speaker in state history; her House Bill 2001 (2019) required larger cities to allow middle housing such as fourplexes.
Elected governor in November 2022, defeating Republican Christine Drazan and unaffiliated candidate Betsy Johnson.
